reproducibility_gaps: No repository license was identified in final Stage 2 or the pinned tree.
No dependency/environment manifest or exact Torch7/CUDA/cuDNN version contract is present.
README gives execution commands but no dependency installation or environment-creation workflow; the R2 setup gate is therefore not met.
PhotoTour dataset payloads are external to the pinned repository and paper-era distribution lineage is only partially recoverable.
Paper/README/evaluation describe 128-D descriptors while the active training source constructs 256-D descriptors.
Random triplet generation and shuffling are present without an explicit seed in the inspected source.
The bundled Liberty model payloads were not deserialized, and no immutable run manifest binds them to an exact environment/training invocation.
No training, evaluation, dataset download, model loading or ROC postprocessing was executed.
notes: R1 reflects a recoverable pinned source, paper relationship, executable entrypoints, architecture/training/evaluation logic and bundled pretrained model artifacts.
R2 is withheld because environment and installation information are not substantially specified.
PN-Net is assessed as non-PINN research code; PINN-specific physics fields are not manufactured.
